svg.title: Filigree with a liner brush, on paper, in five pictures. 1: a C-scroll: one smooth line that curls into a tight spiral, thin, then thicker, then thin. 2: an S-scroll: two curls joined by one curve, turning opposite ways. 3: add a teardrop on each side of the S and a line of three dots that get smaller. 4: paint the same motif mirrored on the other side, so the two touch in the middle. Done: the mirrored motif in gold on a purple swatch, with a dark line under the gold.
